scenes.text: Here is the 50/30/20 budget, a simple way to split your take-home pay.
Start with your take-home pay. Say four thousand dollars a month after tax.
Fifty percent goes to needs: rent, groceries, insurance and minimum loan payments.
Thirty percent goes to wants, like eating out, streaming and travel.
And the last twenty percent goes to savings and paying down extra debt.

steps.label: Take-home pay
steps.headline: Start from your *take-home* pay
steps.detail: Use what lands in your account after tax, not your salary.

steps.label: Needs
steps.headline: Put *50%* toward needs
steps.detail: Rent, groceries, insurance and minimum loan payments.

steps.label: Wants
steps.headline: Keep *30%* for wants
steps.detail: Eating out, streaming, hobbies and travel.

steps.label: Savings
steps.headline: Send *20%* to savings and debt
steps.detail: Emergency fund first, then extra debt payments and investing.
